svg.desc: riemann-masullo at 72a10ff: the 1,983 declarations of the 84 items on C7, each with its kind, file, line and state; 121 declarations with a Deviation: line, quoted; and the items of other directories each item uses.

g.text: riemann-masullo at 72a10ff: the 1,983 declarations of the 84 items on C7, each with its kind, file, line and state; 121 declarations with a Deviation: line, quoted; and the items of other directories each item uses.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Posters: M1, what the targets rest on · M2, the steps with no known repair · M3, the paper by depth · M4, every chapter · M5, the refutations · B1, the works the manuscript cites. Names, items, files, entries and posters are links, underlined under the pointer: a card's title or a Lean name opens the source at the pin.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How to read it. The expansion of C7's cards, in the same order: one block per item, its heading opening the card, and under it, in italics, the first sentence of its first declaration's docstring, quoted. Then the declarations whose docstring states how the Lean departs from the print, each with its Deviation: line quoted from the Lean

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: source (Apache-2.0), then every declaration of the item. A name opens its line at the pin. A declaration's state is read from the terms: open when it uses sorryAx, resting when something open is below it. That a declaration states what its Deviation: line says is the docstring's claim, not checked here.

g.text: There are ordered heights escaping to infinity on both tails at which the finite Euler product is uniformly bounded on the closed strip from -δ to 1 + δ.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Uses the sign convention for index zero from §B.5.3.2 and the Euler factors of §3.2.1, with factor one at ramified places. A positive lower bound on the reciprocal product expresses both the upper bound and avoidance of poles.

g.text: The poles of the S-local correcting factor are the union of the two archimedean families and the periodic lattices at unramified finite places.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: As in §3.3, the complex-place abscissae start at minus half the absolute angular weight. The union allows more than one place to contribute to the same pole.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Each local pole is simple. The count includes coincident poles.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Uses the repaired complex-place sign and shifted finite-place lattice of sLocalRhoFactor_poles_iff.

g.text: Uses the Dirichlet density, written out as this limit. The limit is the body of Mathlib's NumberField.Set.HasDirichletDensity; the pinned Mathlib does not expose that definition and has no lemma that introduces it, so a statement phrased with the predicate itself cannot be proved outside Mathlib's own module.

g.text: The subspace is spanned by homogeneous theta classes whose pole orders on the chosen component satisfy the given bound.

g.text: Eliminating the selected highest local coefficients is equivalent to the global zero-order bound and to membership in either homogeneous principal-value image.

g.text: Uses zero-moment principal-value preimages and a nontrivial component.

g.text: Uses the intersections from (7.3.3.18)–(7.3.3.19) and a nontrivial norm-one character. At the trivial character an ambient Fourier functional restricts to zero. The pole orders use the S′-local Mellin transform and order k selects Laurent exponent −k in the signed convention of Definition 7.1.2.1.

g.text: The real and complex cutoff tuples are combined into a single place-indexed family. Local poles are ranked by positive real norm shifts, so a cutoff of n includes n + 1 local poles.

g.text: An operator of order zero admits a nuclear presentation with rapidly decreasing coefficients.

g.text: The printed span of the first N primal vectors can fail to be invariant. Quotient by the common kernel of the retained derivative functionals. The multiplier is evaluated at z − a for each unshifted zero z.

g.text: Finite sums of adelic tensors have flat archimedean factors and arbitrary finite factors.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Uses the adelic tensor realization of §2.1.3 and the flat jet conditions from §5.3.3. The tensor image carries the subspace topology from the adelic Schwartz space. The display on p. 368 writes the projective tensor topology.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Implements the prose Fourier-moment condition. On a nontrivial norm-one isotype the moment restriction can be imposed on representatives, since the two polar functionals are trivial-isotypic.

text.tspan: · p. 373 · 22 declarations, 3 deviating from the print

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Nuclear endomorphisms of the strong dual of the archimedean quotient have finite rank.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The printed universal nonnuclearity conclusion needs infinite rank, which fails for the zero test.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: This gives the rank criterion on the space carrying the test action.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: A block of length m vanishes when all multiplier derivatives of orders strictly below m vanish at its center. This allows tests whose induced action is zero.
